The institutional investor held 123,338 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $14.11 million, down from 127,694 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cheviot Value Management Llc who had been investing in Microsoft Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $789.25B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.77% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $102.8. About 28.31M shares traded.
